name: Há Fado no Mercado
description: Immerse yourself in the soulful sounds of Fado in the bustling, historic Bolhão Market.
longDescription:
Há Fado no Mercado is a week-long music event bringing traditional Portuguese Fado performances to the Mercado do Bolhão. This initiative aims to present Fado in a non-traditional setting, allowing both locals and visitors to encounter the genre within the daily life of the city's historic market. The event runs annually, offering a series of free performances.

Attendees can expect an informal atmosphere as Fado singers and musicians perform amidst the market stalls. The performances are integrated into the market's operating hours, providing a backdrop of everyday commerce. The historic Mercado do Bolhão, recently renovated, serves as a notable venue, its open structure and bustling environment creating a unique context for the melancholic and expressive music. The event is suitable for all ages and is primarily focused on the musical experience.

Entry to Há Fado no Mercado is free, and no tickets are required; visitors can simply walk in and enjoy the performances. The Mercado do Bolhão is centrally located and easily accessible. It is a 2-minute walk from Bolhão metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F) and a 5-minute walk from Trindade metro station (all lines). Several bus routes also stop nearby. The market itself is wheelchair accessible.
